invented_facts: Aurora 14 can reduce the firm's recurring cloud workstation costs; the source provides no cost comparison or savings estimate.
The 30-billion-parameter model claim in Email 1 omits the required configuration of at least 64 GB of memory.
Aurora 14 will simplify fleet management or result in fewer device types; these are buyer priorities, not established product outcomes.
The GPU handles CAD and simulation locally; the spec does not establish support or performance for those specific workloads.
Storage is user-upgradeable; the spec confirms two M.2 slots but explicitly calls only memory user-upgradeable.
Engineers can work offline on client drawings and sync them when connectivity returns; that workflow is not specified.
Cloud workstations would remain for peak loads while daily tasks shift locally; no workload allocation is supported by the source.
notes: All three emails have subjects and one CTA each, but Email 2 exceeds 120 words. The sequence addresses Morgan's priorities, yet several promised outcomes need evidence or more cautious wording before it is ready to send.
